To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) interaction is important for learning, 2) there are many types of interaction, and 3) the type of interaction that takes place in an OLE is dependent on the type of interaction the OLE supports.

interaction is important in the design of OLEs and that interaction can be achieved by using various techniques and approaches to facilitate the interaction between learners and content, between learners and instructors, and between learners and other learners.

the use of online learning technologies is a viable option for teaching and learning in a variety of disciplines and that the use of these technologies can lead to increased student satisfaction and improved learning outcomes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the role that interaction plays in online learning environments and how to facilitate it through technology.
understanding how to create and maintain interaction among students in online courses and how to facilitate interaction with content and with instructors.
how to design OLEs to promote interaction and engagement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the most successful OLEs are those that incorporate all three interaction types.
interaction is the key to successful OLEs, and this chapter provides a number of techniques that can be implemented in the design and development of OLEs to facilitate interaction.
online learning environments are not the same as face-to-face instruction and require different types of interaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
interaction in an OLE is not a one-size-fits-all approach and that there are a multitude of techniques that can be used to facilitate interaction among learners.
interaction is a critical element for online courses and that the instructor's role in creating a sense of community is crucial to the success of an OLE.
we have developed a model for online learning and have used it to design an OLE that provides the necessary interactions to support the learning of the students in the course.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are ways to facilitate learner interaction in OLEs and that these interactions are not only possible but also essential to the success of the online learner.
interaction can be facilitated in OLEs through the use of a variety of strategies and activities.

there are many opportunities to create and facilitate engagement in OLEs, and that instructors and designers should take advantage of these opportunities to create meaningful interactions between learners and their learning environment.
